findings.message: 1 granule position does not match the samples the packets before it return: the first, at 0xEA, is -9223372036854775808 where the packets give 19456. Only the last page may end the stream early (section A.2). Each later page is compared with the count continued from the position before it.
The granule position of the logical stream 0x0B0B000D goes back once, the first time at 0xE4 from 7168 to -9223372036854775808; players that seek or show the time by it get lost.
The last granule position, 29196 at 0x11D, is 9223372036854775807 samples beyond the count continued from the granule position before it; the packets end before it, so nothing is trimmed.
